correctness.rationale: An explicit count-and-gap formula for the expectation and unrestricted two-median optimum is proved. A two-branch derivative calculation proves that all gap extrema occur at equal spacing or at an infinite-gap limit. Exact integer optimization and strict algebraic comparisons establish the change of dominating branch at fifteen agents, including attainment versus nonattainment. Independent exact-rational pair enumeration checked 13,504 cases and a separate symbolic verifier checked rational derivatives and convexity. The full infinite quantifiers rest on proof, not these finite checks.

originality.rationale: Ma and Peng (arXiv:2608.09061, first posted 2026-08-10) and Chan, Lin and Wang (arXiv:2608.22484, first posted 2026-08-23) introduce/analyze the same rule and global factor four, including qualitative large-population three-site bad profiles. Their inspected relevant full-text definitions, ratio theorems and constructions do not provide the exact all-n three-site law, the integer optimizer or the attained/nonattained transition at fifteen. Specific finite earlier claims cover n=3,4,5 only. Novelty remains subject to unpublished and unindexed equivalences.
residual_risks: Unknown indexed or unindexed exact three-site finite-population result outside inspected sources may imply the proposed theorem.
The theorem does not address arbitrary support sizes greater than three, and earlier general factor-four results remain stronger on domain but weaker in exact finite-population constants.

value.rationale: Exactly three sites is the minimal nontrivial support for positive two-facility optimal cost. This complete exact finite-population optimization identifies the previously unquantified loss from three-location geometry and finds a genuine switch at n=15 from a nonattained separated-gap worst case to an attained equal-gap worst case. The precise threshold, arithmetic optimizer and attainment classification are motivated by the rule and not arbitrary instance improvements.
